structure: Single high-school course document (World History and Civilization). Pages 2-4: context/purpose, C3 and historical thinking skills, acknowledgments (backup). Page 5 onward: one table; row 1 = Learning Outcome for the course; then six chronological domain heading rows (Ancient Cultures and Civilizations ... Era of Global Conflicts, 1900 CE to Present); each standard is a row with C1 = code (WH.d.n) and C2 = standard text; '(E)' marks essential standards. No examples or teacher notes.
